user_query: I am planning a company retreat and I want to ensure it is eco-friendly. Can you provide me with guidelines on sustainable event planning? Also, could you suggest any clean energy sources for the retreat venue? Lastly, can you recommend any email marketing services for promoting the retreat?

TaskList.description: Research and compile guidelines on sustainable event planning.
Identify and list clean energy sources suitable for retreat venues.
Research various email marketing services and evaluate their suitability for promoting the retreat.
